rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Firewalla MCP server by Alex Mittell that provides real-time network monitoring, security analysis, and firewall management through 28 specialized tools compatible with any MCP client. The implementation integrates with Firewalla's MSP API v2 to deliver security alert monitoring, bandwidth usage tracking, device status management, rule operations with pause/resume functionality, and geographic threat analysis with location-based filtering. Built with TypeScript and featuring advanced search capabilities with complex query syntax, boolean field translation, cross-reference correlation scoring, and bulk operations for alarm and rule management, it serves network administrators requiring conversational access to firewall data, security teams needing real-time threat analysis, and IT professionals managing multiple Firewalla devices through AI-powered interfaces for network security monitoring and incident response workflows.
